nginx.siteCreateHint: Fill in at least one of Web Root or Reverse Proxy Address. If a proxy address is provided, config will be generated as reverse proxy; otherwise it follows the site type with auto-created root dir and default index page (index.html for static HTML, index.php for PHP; existing files with the same name will not be overwritten). When PHP is selected, installed php-fpm will be auto-detected and fastcgi_pass written into the config; creation will be refused if no PHP-FPM is detected. nginx -t validation runs on creation and rolls back on failure. SSL and database creation failures will not affect the site itself.
